## Definition of Done / 完成定义

- [ ] All Must Have tasks completed and passing acceptance criteria / 所有必须有任务完成并通过验收标准
- [ ] No S1 or S2 bugs in delivered features / 交付功能中没有S1或S2级别的错误
- [ ] Code reviewed and merged to develop / 代码已审查并合并到develop分支
- [ ] Design documents updated for any deviations from spec / 设计文档已更新以反映与规范的任何偏差
- [ ] Test cases written and executed for all new features / 为所有新功能编写并执行了测试用例
- [ ] Asset naming and format standards met / 满足了资源命名和格式标准
